summary_for_principal: A process step can now say how it should be run: carry on in the open session or start fresh, which agent does it, which kind of model, and what it is shown. Badly formed settings are refused when a definition loads. Definitions without the setting behave as before. The library only carries this; the platform uses it in a later piece of work. Version 0.13.0 is prepared but not tagged.
